review_notes:
Infeasibility check: the only breakfast candidate requires 1,200g Greek yogurt across three mornings. The 1kg tub alone under-covers; 1kg + 500g is the cheapest coverage at S$12.85. Oats 300g, milk 450ml and 3 lemons are covered by pantry. Minimum checkout therefore exceeds S$10.50 by S$2.35.
[复核修正 2026-09-17] 按复核意见删除了教系统怎么答的提示性措辞。只改了 user_request，场景其余字段、候选池与 gold 均未改动。原句：「Use the pantry first, but the actual packaged checkout must stay within S$10.50; if it cannot, say so rather than estimating a per-gram cost.」 → 现句：「Use the pantry first; I can spend at most S$10.50 at the store this time.」

scenario.user_request: Please plan breakfast for two of us for the next three mornings. We have no allergies or foods to exclude, and repeating breakfast is fine. Use the pantry first; I can spend at most S$10.50 at the store this time.

gold.conflict_reason: Three yogurt-oat-bowl breakfasts for two require 400g×3=1,200g Greek yogurt. Pantry covers the other ingredients. The cheapest frozen package coverage is 1×1,000g + 1×500g = 1,500g for S$6.90 + S$5.95 = S$12.85, which is S$2.35 above the S$10.50 budget, so the request is infeasible.
gold.author_rationale: A plausible wrong answer prorates 1.2 kg of yogurt from the larger tub or buys only the 1 kg tub and claims the breakfast plan fits; the smallest package combination that actually covers 1.2 kg costs S$12.85.
